subject: english
stem: This public message contains a rule and a reason. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: an activity kit from the train station may be kept for thirty days
an activity kit from the gym may be kept for seven days
an activity kit from the train station may be kept for seven days
an activity kit from the train station may be kept for one day

an activity kit from the gym may be kept for seven days：此項把「train station」改成「gym」。音稿明確陳述「an activity kit from the train station may be kept for seven days」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an activity kit from the train station may be kept for seven days」。
an activity kit from the train station may be kept for seven days：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「an activity kit from the train station may be kept for seven days」。

an activity kit from the train station may be kept for one day：此項把「seven days」改成「one day」。音稿明確陳述「an activity kit from the train station may be kept for seven days」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an activity kit from the train station may be kept for seven days」。
